description: Converting a tuple of null keywords to a set of any gives a set of one null
notes: The conversion gives a set whose element type is the dynamic pseudo-type, the unification of the two nulls' types, which the spec has no value for: the dynamic pseudo-type is a placeholder for a type that isn't known yet, so no value should have it as a collection's element type. Iterating over the set doesn't avoid that, since its element, a null of the dynamic pseudo-type, has the set's element type. Apart from that, the spec gives the same result: equal elements merge in a set, and two nulls are equal, so one remains. hashicorp/hcl gives such a set (conversionTupleToSet in go-cty's cty/convert/conversion_collection.go).
